overview.description: Under normal market conditions, the fund will pursue its investment objectives by investing primarily in a portfolio of common stock and options contracts, including standardized listed options and/or FLexible EXchange options (“FLEX Options”) that utilize the common stock of NVIDIA Corporation as the reference asset (the “Underlying Security”). It is non-diversified.
